dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What sort of watch is that?

dialogues.speaker: Moniotte
dialogues.text: The famous Lady of the Lake's Tear, of course!

dialogues.speaker: Moniotte
dialogues.text: It's exquisite and small enough to be set upon a ring. That is why it was given that name by Lady Furina herself.

dialogues.speaker: Moniotte
dialogues.text: As her most ardent follower, perhaps I might shorten the distance between myself and my god by finding an accessory as much like it as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Moniotte
dialogues.text: Ah, our beautiful Hydro Archon... her superb makeup, her gentle voice, her agile dance steps... Are they not worthy of a greater, more luxurious stage...?
